items.question: What makes Ceylon cinnamon different from what most supplements use?
items.answer: Nearly all cinnamon supplements are made with Cassia and it matters more than most people realize. Cassia is high in coumarin, which builds up and can stress your liver with regular use. Ceylon from Sri Lanka has almost none, making it the right choice for daily, therapeutic-level supplementation. Our 12-to-1 concentration delivers 7,200mg equivalent of actual Ceylon per softgel, in a bioavailable form your body can put to use.

items.question: How does Metabolae compare to standard cinnamon capsules at the pharmacy?
items.answer: What you'll find at the pharmacy is almost always low-dose Cassia in a basic capsule — minimal potency, minimal absorption. Metabolae uses a 12:1 Ceylon extract delivered in MCT oil. The difference in strength and bioavailability is significant: each softgel delivers the equivalent of 7,200mg of raw Ceylon bark in a form your body can genuinely absorb.

items.question: Is it safe to take alongside my current medications?
items.answer: Most people tolerate Ceylon cinnamon well, but if you're currently managing blood sugar with medication or taking blood thinners, have a conversation with your doctor before you start. That's good practice with any new supplement and worth the phone call.

items.question: When can I expect to notice a difference?
items.answer: Energy and balance improvements tend to show up first, usually within the first 2–4 weeks for people who take it consistently. Blood sugar support takes longer to become measurable; plan for at least 6–8 weeks before drawing conclusions. How quickly you notice a difference depends on your starting point, diet, and daily habits.

accordions.title: How it works
accordions.html:
Most cinnamon supplements don't work because they rely on cheap Cassia powder pressed into hard capsules that are difficult for your stomach to break down properly. The active compounds get stuck in fiber and move through your body largely untouched.

Metabolae takes a different approach. We start with genuine Ceylon cinnamon from Sri Lanka, concentrate it 12-to-1 into a smooth liquid extract, then blend it with MCT oil and encase it in easy-to-swallow softgels.

Once the softgel dissolves, the extract is already suspended in oil, creating a highly bioavailable form your body can take in efficiently.

  • No rough powder.
  • No cinnamon aftertaste hours afterward.
  • No active compounds going to waste.

MCT oil works as a natural transport system, carrying the concentrated Ceylon cinnamon compounds into your bloodstream to support healthy glucose metabolism, circulation, and cellular wellness.

A single softgel each day delivers the equivalent of 7,200 mg of Ceylon cinnamon. The potency that dozens of standard capsules try to match, in a form your body can genuinely absorb.

It's why so many adults over 50 who had written off cinnamon supplements entirely are finally feeling a genuine difference with Metabolae.
